blind.description: A stylized fantasy mimic treasure chest. It consists of a wooden chest with an arched lid, dark iron corner brackets and studded metal bands. The chest lid is cracked open like jaws, revealing sharp pointed ivory teeth lining the rims, a fleshy magenta/pink tongue hanging out the front with three golden coins on it, and a single yellow cat-like eye peering from the keyhole clasp. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering, melted, or broken geometry. Sits directly and flat on the floor on its own base without any added plinth.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular curved wooden lid bordered by two dark studded metal straps, with metal corner reinforcements visible at the edges and a small pink tongue with gold coins protruding from the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 feet tall (about 40-45% of the 5 ft 9 in figure's height) and about 2.8 feet wide.
